eval_model.form: ideal: c0 + c_amp*depth*2^n*n + c_shot*shots; noisy: c0 + shots*(c_noisy*depth*2^n*n) + c_shot*shots
eval_model.fit: non-negative least squares on relative error (each row scaled by 1/measured seconds)

qubit_caps_basis: Measured on this machine: an ideal depth-1 evaluation (256 shots) takes 7.05 s at 24 qubits and a fresh process peaks at 521 MB resident (preflight predicts 1118 MB, deliberately conservative). One more qubit doubles the statevector: the prediction for 25 qubits is 1886 MB, above MEMORY_LIMIT_MB = 1500.0 (set for a 16 GB laptop with about 3.5 GB free), hence MAX_QUBITS = 24. Noisy (fake-backend) simulation runs one trajectory per shot: 6.09 s per 256-shot evaluation at 12 qubits and 30.22 s at 14 qubits (peak 409 MB), i.e. x5.0 for two more qubits, hence MAX_QUBITS_NOISE = 14.
